label: check029
claim: Elastic endpoints reproduce but exceed core/face admissibility; inherited core loses ellipticity and the foam-law comparison is not empirical gamma.
source_report_body: CHECK MAINLINE-029 on my own axisymmetric StVK model (owner code not read or run). The card's arithmetic and lead results reproduce: 64 of 66 normalisations exactly (the two widths follow 015's nu 0.30, as stated); weak-meridian endpoints 78.631/90.736 kPa against 78.627/90.722, all 14 within 0.032%, each a true limit point, unchanged on 4x meshes; eigenpressures within 0.0063% on the owner's meshes; face stresses within 1.7%; transfer40 within 0.15%; 21 arithmetic items. Objections (NFI.json): (1) The endpoints are not attainable: the core's flank shear passes the card's own Hexcel CR III strength at 18-41 kPa and reaches 4.8-7.4 times it at the limits (mesh-converged); faces pass 345 MPa at 43-59 kPa. (2) The card's core law (in-plane E 0.01 MPa) loses ellipticity at 0.088 MPa shear, reached at 7-11 kPa; refined meshes go unstable on the flank below the endpoints, but stay stable to the limits at 1 MPa. (3) With that core, 021b's lowest linear mode is face wrinkling near 197.4 kPa, below 203.245/234.532. (4) The EUCASS elastic endpoints 13.957/13.844 MPa are StVK foam collapse; they fall with core refinement (13.37 at 12 elements), so 13.96 against 6.03 measures the foam law. Linear gap: 42.80 mm as mid radius gives 28.08 (+2.0%); E_steel 187 GPa closes it; unestablished. Fix cards proposed: core and face admissibility; a crushable foam law. Seven simjob refusals were retried unchanged under the standing order, which this report also closes. QUESTIONABLE; no certification.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
